title: Numbers to 10: Count, Order and Ten Frames
seo_title: Kindergarten Numbers to 10 Worksheets: Free Math with Pictures and Answers (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Number concepts to 10: one-to-one correspondence, conservation, cardinality, stable order counting, sequencing 1-10, linking sets to numerals, subitizing
meta_desc: Free Kindergarten math worksheets on numbers to 10 for the BC curriculum: count objects, zero, numbers and words, before and after, ten frames and counting stories. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: The last number you say tells how many.
key_sub: Touch each thing once as you count. Moving things does not change how many.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Touch each thing once and say one number for each.
  • The last number you say tells how many.
  • Moving things around does not change how many there are.
  • 0 (zero) is the number for none.

Examples

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do
Counting one thing twiceTouch each thing as you count, or move it to one side.
Thinking a spread-out row has moreCount both rows. Moving them does not change the number.
Mixing up before and afterAfter means count on one. Before means count back one.

faq.q: What does number concepts to 10 mean in Kindergarten?
faq.a: Children count objects to 10 one at a time, know the last number tells how many, put numbers 1 to 10 in order and link each number to a group of objects.

faq.q: How can I help my child count accurately?
faq.a: Ask your child to touch or move each object as they say one number. Then ask, How many? The last number said is the answer.
A box of 10 squares in two rows of 5. Children see quickly that a full row is 5 and a full frame is 10.
Yes. Zero is the number for none, such as an empty plate.
